Empirical test of self-reflection with external feedback disallowed; reports when reflection helps or hurts; contributes to verification as the self-evaluated signal.
AIVRIL2 self-verifying multi-agent RTL framework; reported claims are VerilogEval pass rates and 3.4x code-quality gain, not the correction loop.
OpenCodeInterpreter system with execution feedback; claims are HumanEval/MBPP accuracy versus GPT-4, not about the refinement mechanism.
Multi-agent optimizer with feedback loops; case-study claims are output quality, relevance and actionability, not measurements of the loop itself.
LATTE's delta-view feedback localizes faults to drive repair; reports refinement success rate (46.08%/25.51%); contributes to verification.
Query2CAD is a CAD-generation framework; headline claims are success rates on their CAD dataset, i.e. task outcomes, not the self-refine loop.
Interactive-KBQA framework built for KBQA; claims are competitive results on WebQSP, CWQ, KQA Pro and MetaQA.
Continuous diffusion for categorical data; the 'iterative refinement' is diffusion sampling, not a language-model agent's control loop.
Deep RL for job-shop scheduling with LLM-assisted reward design; the loop is RL policy training, not an LLM agent loop.
MCQG-SRefine applies self-critique to USMLE question generation; claims are expert satisfaction with question quality and difficulty.
Analyses self-repair across Code Llama/GPT-3.5/GPT-4, measures cost-adjusted gains and shows feedback quality is the bottleneck; retry/repair.
LLM-ARC's automated reasoning critic runs tests and feeds failures back; compared against LLM-only baselines showing the refinement loop matters; verification.
Diagnoses self-evaluated feedback quality as the bottleneck of reflection and proposes contrastive checklists to fix it; contributes to verification.
AlphaLLM couples MCTS search over language states with critic models in a self-improving loop; search is the iteration policy.
Critical survey of self-correction research; secondary study, retained as a snowballing seed.
SiDyP iteratively refines noisy label candidates with a simplex diffusion model; no language-model agent loop.
ARCS agentic RAG code-synthesis system; reported claims are generation and translation quality on Geeks4Geeks and HumanEval.
AIR is an instruction-data generation pipeline; claims are downstream instruction-following gains from AIR-10K, not about the refinement loop.
Iterative refinement here is k-means resampling of finetuning data across training iterations; not an agent control loop.
Healthcare simulation workflow wiring up off-the-shelf prompt chaining, RAG and iterative refinement; results are 70-80% scenario development time saved.
Overview article on prompt types, pitfalls and ethics; no method and no loop contribution.
RCoT detects factual inconsistency by reconstructing the problem and turns it into fine-grained feedback for revision; compared against CoT, self-consistency and Self-Refine; verification.
Compares Multi-Agent 1 (initializer, critic, scorer) against Multi-Agent 2 (initializer, critic) on TSP/mTSP; the agent arrangement is the studied variable: control topology.
EvoMDT self-evolving multi-agent MDT system; claims are guideline concordance, BERTScore, safety violations and physician-rated decision quality.
Med-PaLM 2 reports MedQA/MedMCQA accuracy and physician preference; ensemble refinement is a component, the claims are clinical task outcomes.
OpenScholar system plus ScholarQABench; claims are answer correctness and citation accuracy, not the self-feedback loop as such.
MAGIC auto-generates self-correction guidelines and compares them against expert-written ones, analysing why corrections succeed; retry/repair.
PREFER is a prompt-ensemble boosting pipeline; the reported claims are state-of-the-art task performance across task types.
Maps expert steering feedback across 30 multi-turn transcripts to Socratic stages and reports 74% of initially failed problems solved; retry/repair after a failed attempt.
Directly compares single-step prompting against the iterative refinement cycle (and human mentors) on quality and time; the iteration policy is the studied variable.
Tests whether VLMs can self-correct across iterative inference turns and finds they cannot without training; a claim about retry/repair.
Same study, arXiv record: two-turn self-correction measured at inference and used for preference training; claim is about retry/repair, not task score alone.
ICLEF uses self-critique and expert feedback to build distillation data; the resulting student models have no runtime loop.
SR-MCTS combines MCTS with Self-Refine and is compared against ToT and rStar on search efficiency; the iteration policy is the contribution.
Perspective-taking prompting has the model self-regulate within its response; a prompting strategy with no iterative control returning to the model.
MorphAgent's claims are task performance and adaptability against existing multi-agent frameworks, not a study of the arrangement as a variable.
Agents review each other with confidence levels and revise; shows feedback exchange beats solution sharing and confidence helps; control topology is the studied variable.
Tree of Thoughts searches over reasoning states with self-evaluation, lookahead and backtracking; search is the iteration policy.
Diffusion model for symbolic music; iterative refinement steps are sampling, not a language-model agent's loop.
Overview/tutorial on prompt engineering for generative AI tools; no method and no loop mechanism studied.
PromptWizard optimizes prompts via critique-and-synthesis; claims are performance across 45 tasks plus API cost, not the loop mechanism.
Treefinement is a tree search over program repairs driven by verifier feedback, plus filtering to stop reward hacking; verification governs what the loop does next.
Study of how students prompt LLMs for assignments; no agentic control loop is proposed or studied.
CorNav is a zero-shot VLN framework; claims are that it outperforms 7 baselines across four navigation tasks on NavBench.
